title: The Recipe Book — EN/ES/FR (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 98bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate Spanish French language learning family Perth cooking memory
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The recipe book is held together by a rubber band and intention
Its pages are splattered with the evidence of every mention
Of a meal that was good enough to make again someday
The recipe book is the family's food autobiography in disarray

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El libro de recetas está sujeto con una goma y con intención
[The recipe book is held together by a rubber band and intention]
Sus páginas están salpicadas con la evidencia de cada mención
[Its pages are splattered with the evidence of every mention]
De una comida lo suficientemente buena para hacerla de nuevo
[Of a meal good enough to make again]
El libro de recetas es la autobiografía culinaria de lo nuevo
[The recipe book is the culinary autobiography of the new]

[Chorus — English]
The recipe book knows something I don't know
It knows the meals behind the memories and how they flow
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le livre de recettes est maintenu par un élastique et l'intention
[The recipe book is held together by a rubber band and intention]
Ses pages sont tachées avec la preuve de chaque mention
[Its pages are splattered with the evidence of every mention]
D'un repas assez bon pour être refait un jour
[Of a meal good enough to be made again one day]
Le livre de recettes est l'autobiographie familiale — toujours
[The recipe book is the family autobiography — always]

[Outro — All three languages]
Recipe book knows… El libro de recetas sabe… Le livre de recettes sait
The meals hold the memory — Las comidas guardan la memoria — Les repas gardent la mémoire
The gardens still growing
